questions.question:
**In the sentence identify the segment which contains the grammatical error.**

Due to the Cyclone Idai vast areas of land have been flooded, roads destroyed and communications disrupting in Zimbabwe and Mosambique.

options.text: vast areas of land have been flooded

questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 4.**

*Due to** Cyclone Idai **vast areas of land have been flooded, roads destroyed __and communications disrupting__ in Zimbabwe and Mosambique*.

It can be clearly observed that the sentence is in past participle form from the words **'have been flooded, roads destroyed'.**

So, we will use the past participle form of the verb **'disrupt' **i.e **'disrupted'.**

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'worker'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the absence of manual workers to clean the streets, explicitly stating that the town has no manual workers. This implies that the position being referenced involves manual labor tasks.
 
• The passage notes that the last worker "retired six months ago." This terminology commonly refers to regular employees or laborers rather than officials or high-ranking personnel.
 
• The mention that they haven't hired anyone since the retirement of the last individual suggests that the role is specific and essential for day-to-day operations, which aligns with the role of a manual worker.
 
• Other mentioned roles, such as the mayor and councilors, are already identified as performing duties usually outside of their primary responsibilities because of the absence of workers, further emphasizing the need for manual workers.
 
• The mayor's comment about being "blocked by bureaucracy" when it comes to hiring points to administrative challenges in replacing essential staff, reinforcing that the blank pertains to a key operational role likely filled by a worker.

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 (councillor): This role is not typically associated with manual labor; they are elected officials involved in policy-making. 
 
• Option 2 (member): This term is too generic and does not fit the specific reference to manual labor duties.
 
• Option 3 (mayor): This option is irrelevant as the passage already describes the mayor doing tasks outside his usual scope due to the absence of manual workers.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

The State Government argued that it could not ______ the increase in the teachers' salaries as awarded by the court.
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 1.**

*The State Government argued that it could not __afford __the increase in the teachers' salaries as awarded by the court. *

Afford means have (a resource such as money or time) available or to spare. 

'Afford' is the correct word as the sentence states that the government did not have enough resources to spare so as to increase the teachers' salaries.

**So, options 2, 3 and 4 are incorrect.**

questions.question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.

A. That sort of pollution, which is also widespread in other south east Asian nations, regularly kills wildlife like whales and turtles that ingest the waste.

B. Environmental groups have tagged the Philippines as one of the world's biggest ocean polluters due to its reliance on single-use plastic.

C. In Thailand also, a whale died last year after swallowing more than 80 plastic bags.

D. In the latest case, a whale with 40 kilos of plastic trash in its stomach died on Saturday in southern Philippines where it was stranded a day earlier.
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 3.**

The first statement should be B i.e *'Environmental groups have tagged the Philippines as one of the world's biggest ocean polluters due to its reliance on single-use plastic.*' It gives an introduction of what is being talked about in the following statements.

After B, it should be A i.e *'That sort of pollution, which is also widespread in other southeast Asian nations, regularly kills wildlife like whales and turtles that ingest the waste.*' In the previous statement, ocean pollution was mentioned so, B gives the consequences of this pollution.

After A, it should be D as it talks about a case in the Philippines and after D, it should be C as it talks about a case in Thailand.

The correct order is **BADC.**

**So, options 1,2 and 4 are incorrect.**

questions.question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

The main gate of the building was being guarded by gun-totting guards.

options.text: The main gate of the building were guarding gun-totting guards.
Gun-totting guards were guarding the main gate of the building.
Gun-totting guards have been guarding the main gate of the building.
Gun-totting guards guarded the main gate of the building.

questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 2** i.e

*Gun-totting guards were guarding the main gate of the building.*

Firstly, the 'main gate' becomes the object and 'gun-totting guards' become the subject. Since the passive form contains 'was being guarded' , so it means that the active form is in past continuous form. Therefore, we remove 'being' and convert the verb into the past continuous form i.e 'guarding'.

**So, options 1,3 and 4 are incorrect.**

questions.solution:

questions.question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

Do not park your car in front of my house.

options.text: My house should not be parked in front of your car.
Your car could not be parked in front of my house
Your car need not be parked in front of my house.
Your car should not be parked in front of my house

questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 4.**

*Your car should not be parked in front of my house.*

In case of a command, while converting to the passive voice we first write the object i.e. car, then 'not be' and lastly the third form of verb i.e 'parked'.

**So, options 1,2 and 3 are incorrect.**

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select No improvement.

I l__ook for a better job__ for the last two months, but nothing is in sight

options.text: have looked for a better job
have been looking for a better job

questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 2.**

*I __ have been looking for a better job__ for the last two months, but nothing is in sight.*

The phrase 'for the last two months' states that the speaker has started an activity in the past which is being continued in the present. So, we will use the present perfect continuous tense i.e. have been looking.

**So, options 1,3 and 4 are incorrect.**

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 2.
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 2.**

* In fact, (2)__ he __was sweeping the piazza*

In the sentence, the mayor is being talked about. So, we will use 'he'. 

'It' is not used before persons.

'They' is plural so it cannot be used before 'was'.

**So, options 1,3 and 4 are incorrect.**

questions.question: Select the wrongly spelt word.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **examplify**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"examplify"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"exemplify"**, which means to illustrate or clarify by giving an example. (उदाहरण प्रस्तुत करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Her achievements exemplify the importance of hard work and dedication.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **examplify**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options with their meanings:

 
• **Example** (उदाहरण): A representative form or pattern.

 
 
• **Example: **An example of her work is displayed in the gallery.
 
 
 
• **Exhale** (सांस छोड़ना): To breathe out.
 
 
• **Example: **He took a deep breath and then exhaled slowly.
 
 
 
• **Exempt** (मुक्त): Free from an obligation or liability imposed on others.
 
 
• **Example: **His income is exempt from taxes.

questions.question:

Scientists at Cambridge University are ______ how plants can give us sustainable energy.
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 1.**

*Scientists at Cambridge University are __investigating __how plants can give us sustainable energy. *

**Investigating **means **to carry out research or study into (a subject or problem, typically one in a scientific or academic field).**

**Inspecting **means** to look at (someone or something) closely, typically to assess their condition or to discover any shortcomings.**

**Scrutinizing **means** to examine or inspect closely and thoroughly.**

**Looking** means** to direct one's gaze in a specified direction.**

After B, it is A i.e. ' The elephant tusks were tracked from the Democratic Republic of Congo for two months.' It describes how the tusks were tracked.
